# ISE Residencies

> Directory of industry residency positions for Irish software engineering students.

This site lists R1, R2, R3, and R4 residency positions from companies partnered with Irish universities.

## API

Public JSON API for programmatic access:

### List Residencies
GET /api/residencies

Query parameters:
- type: Filter by R1, R1+R2, R2, R3, R4
- location: Filter by location (partial match)
- limit: Results per page (default 50, max 100)
- format: "json" (default) or "markdown"

Examples:
- /api/residencies
- /api/residencies?type=R1
- /api/residencies?location=Dublin
- /api/residencies?format=markdown

### Get Single Residency
GET /api/residencies/{id}

Query parameters:
- format: "json" (default) or "markdown"

## Rate Limits

- 60 requests/minute for list endpoint
- 120 requests/minute for single item endpoint

## Data Structure

Each residency includes:
- id: Unique identifier
- residencyType: R1, R1+R2, R2, R3, or R4
- residencyTitle: Position title
- jobTitle: Role name
- description: Full job description
- location: Office location
- monthlySalary: Compensation info
- accommodationSupport: Housing assistance details
- emailAddress: Application contact
- company: { name, website, imageUrl }
- createdAt: Posting date
